core_obligations: The author decomposes the proper-coloring region into disjoint half-open simplicial chambers determined by graph ascent/descent statistics, identifies unimodular rays and fundamental parallelepiped lattice points, and obtains a full multivariate rational transform. Specializing vertex variables then gives every integer-weight q-chromatic generating function. The graph-statistic chamber decomposition and exact boundary control are the original core; all-ones q-binomial/symmetry specializations are bundled or context, not additional counts.
